text: Your review rhythm can live in your calendar: Rhythm > Add the rhythm to my calendar adds each review as a repeating event, with its checklist inside. A newer file updates those events, it never doubles them.
Vantage is here: your next step, leadership rituals, the review rhythm, top risks, decisions, exceptions, tools, KPIs and KRIs, playbooks and progress.
Principles now come from the estate's one shared list: when one improves, every app gets it at its next update. See them in Settings.
